keyframe_review.note: New keyframe; Cliopatria has no row for Kexholm County (its Swedish Empire shapes of 1617-1721 contain the land). The page says the county 'extended to the parishes of Lieksa in the north and of Suojärvi in the east' and was bordered by Viborg and Nyslott County to the south and west; it gives no boundary, so the polygon is a rough fit to those anchors. The county is dated 1634 in the infobox ('Established: 1634'); the land was Swedish from 1617.

ledger.note: 9 March [O.S. 27 February] 1617: the Treaty of Stolbovo cedes Kexholm. 'Sweden gained the province of Kexholm in Karelia and the province of Ingria, including the fortress of Nöteborg'; the war is 'fought between the Swedish Empire and the Russian Tsardom between 1610 and 1617'. The Kexholm County page: 'ceded to Sweden by Russia together with Ingria by the Treaty of Stolbovo in 1617'; the county itself is established in 1634 (infobox). The land of the polygon is the researcher's fit to the page's parishes.

ledger.note: 30 August 1721: the Treaty of Nystad. 'Southern and eastern parts were ceded to Russia in 1721' (infobox 'Treaty of Nystad: 30 August 1721'); 'the remaining territory was reorganized as the County of Kymmenegård and Nyslott'. The page does not say which parishes went; the whole polygon is carried as lost at confidence 2, and the remainder reorganised as the other county is not modelled here. The page is silent on a 1710 Russian capture.

wars.outcome: The Treaty of Stolbovo (9 March 1617, O.S. 27 February): Sweden gained Kexholm and Ingria with Nöteborg, Novgorod and other wartime gains were returned to Russia, and Russia renounced claims to Estonia and Livonia.
wars.note: The page dates the war 1610-1617 (fought between the Swedish Empire and the Russian Tsardom); it names no battle for Kexholm.

notes: Swedish crown possession (county established 1634 per the infobox; the land was Swedish from 1617). The earlier Swedish occupation of Kexholm that ended at Teusina in 1595 ('abandon the occupied territories of Kexholm and Ingria') is not dated by an opened page and is not drawn here (see swedish-ingria, which has the Ingrian side 1583-1595). Cliopatria's Swedish Empire shapes of 1617-1721 already contain this land; the dossier is a colour tint of Sweden's. Capital coordinates are the researcher's (Priozersk is not in the gazetteer) and the polygon is the researcher's fit to the page's parishes. Kymmenegård and Nyslott County (the remainder after 1721) needs its own dossier.
